
Library imports
```{python}
#
import pandas as pd
import toml
from dotenv import load_dotenv
from os import getenv

#SQL Database Imports
from sqlalchemy import create_engine, MetaData, text, insert
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
```

Load runtime settings
```{python}
#Return an object containing all runtime settings
def load_settings():
    #Load env settings
    load_dotenv(override=True)

    #Load toml settings from config
    config = toml.load("./config.toml")

    settings = {
        #SQL Connection settings
        "sql_address": getenv("SQL_ADDRESS"),
        "sql_database": config["database"]["sql_database"],

        #Data to pull
        "sus_spell_script": ("./" + config["struct"]["script_dir"] + 
                            config["data_scripts"]["ds_sus_spell"])
    }

    return settings

settings = load_settings()
```

```{python}
#Establish a connection to the database
def db_connect(server_address, database, 
               server_type="mssql", driver="SQL+Server"):
    
    #Create Connection String
    conn_str = (f"{server_type}://{server_address}/{database}"
                f"?trusted_connection=yes&driver={driver}")
    
    #Create SQL Alchemy Engine object
    engine = create_engine(conn_str, use_setinputsizes=False)
    return engine

def load_data_from_query(engine, query):
    with engine.connect() as con:
        res = pd.read_sql_query(query, con)

    return res
```

Import datasets
```{python}

#Connect to DB
engine = db_connect(settings["sql_address"], settings["sql_database"])

#SUS Spell data
##Load the SQL Script
with open(settings["sus_spell_script"]) as file:
    query_sus_spell = text(file.read())

df_sus_spell = load_data_from_query(engine, query_sus_spell)
```
